name: vocab-trainer
description: Manage the connected Vocab Trainer Chinese word and grammar library with authenticated CRUD tools.

interface.longDescription: Register, find, edit and delete Chinese words and grammar in your Vocab Trainer library. Google login approves a scoped connection. Track durable operations and manage Group A/B memberships.
interface.defaultPrompt: 중국어 단어와 문법을 Vocab Trainer에 등록하고 관리해줘.
